description: Parks n Paws helps travelers find hand-reviewed dog-friendly hotels near US national parks. Each listing highlights practical pet-policy details such as fees, weight limits, breed restrictions, location, and dog-friendly amenities. We include honest pros and cons plus local tips like nearby vets, dog-friendly dining, and the best season to visit. The directory covers more than 1,300 hotels across 60 US national parks and 25 other iconic parks and monuments.
